description: This file defines a mutable implementation of the Permissions interface, including methods for creating, managing, and serializing permission sets within the Eclipse Ditto project. It involves handling permission collections, JSON serialization, and utility methods.

classes.name: MutablePermissions
classes.description: A mutable implementation of the Permissions interface, managing a set of Permission objects with support for JSON serialization and predefined static constructors.

methods.name: MutablePermissions(final Set<Permission> permissions)
methods.description: Constructor initializing permissions with a set of Permission objects.

methods.name: MutablePermissions(final Collection<Permission> permissions)
methods.description: Constructor initializing permissions from a collection, using EnumSet for internal storage.

methods.name: static Permissions none()
methods.description: Creates and returns an empty Permission set.

methods.name: static Permissions all()
methods.description: Creates and returns a Permission set containing all known permissions.

methods.name: static Permissions of(final Permission permission, final Permission... furtherPermissions)
methods.description: Creates a Permission set initialized with given permissions.

methods.name: boolean contains(final Permission permission, final Permission... furtherPermissions)
methods.description: Checks if the Permission set contains the specified permissions.

methods.name: boolean add(final Permission permission)
methods.description: Adds a permission to the set.

methods.name: Iterator<Permission> iterator()
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the permissions.

methods.name: JsonObject toJson(final JsonSchemaVersion schemaVersion, final Predicate<JsonField> thePredicate)
methods.description: Serializes the permission set to a JSON object, considering all Permission values.

methods.name: JsonObject toJson(final JsonPointer pointer)
methods.description: Serializes the permission set to a JSON object based on a specific JSON pointer.
